word.name: JSON Schema for the concept of nostr events
word.title: JSON Schema for the Concept of Nostr Events
word.description: This is the JSON Schema for elements of the concept of nostr events. Every element of this concept must validate against this JSON schema.

jsonSchema.name: nostr event
jsonSchema.title: Nostr Event
jsonSchema.description: JSON Schema for elements of the concept of nostr events

id.name: id
id.title: ID
id.description: 32-byte lowercase hex SHA256 hash of the serialized event fields

pubkey.name: pubkey
pubkey.title: Pubkey
pubkey.description: 32-byte lowercase hex public key of the event author

kind.name: kind
kind.title: Kind
kind.description: Integer classifying the event type and replaceability (0–65535)

content.name: content
content.title: Content
content.description: Arbitrary string payload; interpretation depends on the kind

sig.name: sig
sig.title: Signature
sig.description: 64-byte lowercase hex Schnorr signature of the event's SHA256 hash
